title: v2 dashboard import: datasource remap of query variables must keep refresh (including 'never')
answers: Imported v2 dashboard variable no longer refreshes on time range change
query variable refresh reset to onDashboardLoad after import
Should I upgrade refresh 'never' when clearing variable options on import?
Export for sharing externally then import loses variable settings
body:
Symptom: After a v2 dashboard is exported 'for sharing externally' and imported through the UI import dialog, query variables with refresh 'onTimeRangeChanged' (or 'never') come back as 'onDashboardLoad'. Variables then stop re-evaluating when the time range changes, and the data resolves against the default range with no error shown.
Root cause: public/app/features/manage-dashboards/import/utils/inputs.ts:replaceVariableDatasources rebuilt each remapped QueryVariable spec with an explicit `refresh` override. First it was hardcoded, then 'never' was forced to 'onDashboardLoad'.
Fix pattern: when you rebuild a spec, spread the original `variable.spec` and override only the fields tied to the old datasource: `query.datasource`, `options: []` and `current`. Do not override author settings such as `refresh`. 'never' is safe even with cleared options, because transformSaveModelSchemaV2ToScene never seeds query variable options from the spec, and SceneVariableSet runs validateAndUpdate on activation without consulting refresh.
Constraints: this applies only to the v2 path (applyV2Inputs → replaceDatasourcesInDashboard). Variables that keep a `$datasourceVar` reference keep their options and are not rebuilt. The v1 import path never touches refresh. The export side leaves refresh alone, so any import-side change to it is round-trip data loss.
applies: V2 dashboard UI import: datasource remapping of QueryVariables in manage-dashboards/import/utils/inputs.ts
